Name: Spamton Dog for Adopt n' Skin and Alternative Textures
Author: TerraTerraCotta
Description:
[size=4][u][b]Description[/b][/u][/size]
Getting back into the retexture scene for Stardew, I knew it in my heart that someone out there wants this very VERY much.

So I've done it. I've used custom sprites on the spriter's resource and made it so you can have spamton be your dog in Stardew Valley. I chose the dog since thtey are more active so you can happily watch one or multiple Spamtons running around all over the place. Enjoy


[u][b]CREDITS[/b][/u]
Skins were reformatted, tested, and put together by TerraTerraCotta.
[i](These Skins were tested using Adopt N' Skin and Alternative Textures)[/i]

Sprites were created by [b][url=https://www.spriters-resource.com/submitter/saidFayad5/]saidFayad5[/url][/b] on the Spriter's Resource as a part of their [url=https://www.spriters-resource.com/custom_edited/deltarunecustoms/sheet/166580/]Spamton Super Mario Flash 2 Sprite set[/url]
